notes: IsHeroSelectActive. lobby UI object = lobby EA (DAT_7ff651813e18) vfunc +0xE0 -> vfunc +0x10; 0x103b930(obj, guid) looks up var {0x40000, low16(guid)} in the object's var bag (obj vfunc +0x48, 0xf64bb0) and returns its truthiness (0xee8a80); false if the object or var is missing.

computes: True when m_entity has component 0x13 (PlayerIdentity), its account id (comp13 +0xA0) is a party member with state 5..7 (0xcd9e90), the party has more than one member (+0xB8 > 1) and feature flag #9 (DAT_7ff651839db4) is 0. False otherwise. Always returns true.
source: entity comp 0x13 +0xA0; lobby party comp 0x60; feature flag #9
calls: (m_entity sub-eval result feeds the entity-map lookup; decompile hides it); 0xc47500 party; 0xcd9e90 member-in-party
notes: Name idea [?]: IsInLocalPartyWithOthers / IsPartyMember. Feature flag #9 set disables it (opposite of b53e9d8c). No null check on the scope EA [G].

computes: If m_entity has no component 0x01: true. If it has 0x01 and component 0x04: comp04 +0x100 == null. If it has 0x01 but no 0x04: returns true WITHOUT writing the output. Invalid/missing entity: false. Returns false (fail) if SyncMgr is null.
notes: Unwritten output stays as the caller's init (GetBool inits INT 0 -> reads false). Meaning of comp04 +0x100 unknown ("model not set/loaded"?) [?].

computes: True when the owner entity's EA (SyncMgr +0x450 comp -> +8 entity -> +0x28 EA) is the scope-4 EA (*(DAT_7ff651797fc0)+0xB8), the lobby UI var 0x0d8...4aa is false/missing, and the client state byte *(DAT_7ff651797fd0) is 6 or 8. Always returns true.
source: scope-4 EA; lobby UI var 0x0d8...4aa; state byte at *DAT_7ff651797fd0
calls: 0xc031b0 scope-4 EA; 0x103b930 UI var; 0xbfce10 read byte
notes: Complement of e2c530ff in the UI var. Brief lists 0xbfce10 as assert/logging: it is a getter returning *(byte*)arg (here *DAT_7ff651797fd0). Meaning of states 6/8 unknown (LobbyScripts 6f24eb76 also tests ==6) [?].

inputs: m_entity(CV entity) -> entity tested; m_filter(CVFilter*) -> filter STU (passed raw, not evaluated)
computes: True when m_entity passes m_filter: SyncMgr vfunc +0x168 (0x1073d80)(inst, entityId, filter). Null filter -> true; entity not found -> false; else team/flag mask tests (0x102f3e0 on comp 0x10), 0xf45880 and 0x1073b50. Always returns true.
source: SyncMgr filter evaluation: entity comp 0x10 FilterBits, filter STU fields +0x10..+0x38
notes: GetEntityPassesFilter. Decompile hides the entity id (shows DAT_a0c8); disassembly passes the evaluated id. Filter semantics belong to the CVFilter work (heavily used: 185 uses).

inputs: a67f0501(CVDynamic*) -> dynamic var identifying the stack slot (raw, via var bag vfunc +0xF8); m_stackPriority(CV GUID) -> priority asset
computes: True when this priority may take the slot: looks up the priority asset (0x9c6470; +8 float priority, +0xC bool wins-ties), finds the slot's current holder in a SyncMgr table (inst+0x10 +0x10, 8 buckets, keyed by the var id from var vfunc +400); true if no holder, holder is the given one, new priority > holder priority (+0xB8), or equal and wins-ties. False if either input is null or the asset is missing. Returns false (fail) if inst is null.
source: instance var bag (inst+0x98), SyncMgr priority-holder table, priority asset
notes: Name idea [?]: CanTakeStackPriority. param_4 of 0xf4d1d0 is 0 here, so "holder == self" never short-circuits.

computes: Using gamepad: SyncMgr +0x450 (component back-ref) vfunc +0x30 -> object; bit 15 of u16 at +0x0A. False when that object is null. Returns false (fail) if SyncMgr is null.
source: input state object reached from the owner component (comp +0x450 vfunc +0x30)
notes: GetUsingGamepad. Server: per-client input mode, likely irrelevant/false.

computes: True when the hero GUID is in the lobby profile's owned-product set (0xce7fe0(profile, hero), profile +0x90). False if the GUID is 0 or there is no profile. Always returns true.
notes: Documented in LobbyScripts.md. Name idea [?]: IsHeroOwned.

computes: Output = !(comp01 +0x180 & 1) of m_entity; true if the entity has no component 0x01. Invalid/missing entity: false. Returns false (fail) if SyncMgr is null.
source: entity comp 0x01 +0x180 bit 0 (scene flag); comp 0x22 FirstPerson +0x20 viewmodel entity
notes: When the bit is set the code also walks comp 0x22 -> viewmodel entity -> its comp01 +0x180, but every path writes false, so it has no effect [G]. Bit meaning unknown (hidden?) [?]; name idea IsVisible [?].

computes: True when the first/selected matchmaking ticket (0xd53ea0 over [lobbyEA+0x1B8]+0x18, 0x90 stride) exists, has +0x80 != 0 and its state byte (+0x78)+4 == 6 ("Searching"). Always returns true.
notes: Documented in LobbyScripts.md / LobbyServer.md. Name idea [?]: IsSearchingForMatch.

computes: True when the owner entity's EA is the scope-4 EA (*(DAT_7ff651797fc0)+0xB8), the lobby UI var 0x0d8...4aa is true, and *(DAT_7ff651797fd0) state byte is 6 or 8. Always returns true.
source: scope-4 EA; lobby UI var 0x0d8...4aa; state byte at *DAT_7ff651797fd0
calls: 0xc031b0 scope-4 EA; 0x103b930 UI var; 0xbfce10 read byte
notes: Counterpart of c29cf678 (UI var true instead of false).

inputs: m_entity(CV entity) -> candidate entity; e5e4595a(CV entity) -> capture-area entity
computes: True when m_entity's id is in the capture area's entity list: e5e4595a entity -> component 0x1A (STUCaptureAreaComponent) list at +0x98 (u32 ids, 8-byte stride). Returns false (fail, output unwritten) if either id is invalid, the area entity is missing or has no 0x1A; also if SyncMgr is null.
notes: Name idea [?]: IsEntityInCaptureArea. Server must maintain the 0x1A occupant list (mirrored?) for capture logic.

inputs: m_entity(CV entity) -> entity; m_raycast(CV bool, default false) -> require visibility; m_distance(CV float, default 0) -> max view depth
computes: True when m_entity (with component 0x01) is in front of the camera (EA vfunc +0xE8 -> +0x48) with 0 < depth < m_distance and, if m_raycast, the render-view visibility record (EA comp 0x5B, 0xce4fd0) says visible. False otherwise. Returns false (fail) if SyncMgr is null or the scope EA fails the type check.
source: comp 0x01 world position (0x964bc0), camera, EA comp 0x5B RenderViewState per-entity visibility byte
calls: 0x964bc0 world pos; 0xa1fa70 projection/depth; 0xcdff50 GetFloat; 0xd16bf0 GetBool; 0xc54b80 comp 0x5B; 0xce4fd0 visibility query
notes: Visibility is asynchronous: 0xce4fd0 registers the entity and returns the previous result (+0xC), so the first query is false [G, inferred timing]. Depth is the projected clip value, not Euclidean distance [?]. Client/camera only. Name idea [?]: IsEntityInView.

computes: Returns feature flag #0x13 (DAT_7ff651839e2c, default 1). Always returns true.
source: feature-flag table (0x7e4300 init: id 0x13, mode 1, value 1)
notes: LobbyScripts.md: gates the custom-game button. Default true; mode 1 so the "used" marker is never set.

inputs: m_entity(CV entity) -> entity (evaluated in inst vfunc +0x30 = the instance itself)
computes: Resolves m_entity's player link (0x101c460: own component 0x20, or the owner's via comp 0x1F) -> that component's entity -> component 0x34 PlayerSlotLists +0x110 byte. If any link is missing it returns true WITHOUT writing the output. Returns false (fail) if inst/SyncMgr is null.
notes: No invalid-id check before the lookup. Meaning of comp34 +0x110 unknown [?].

inputs: 1506e063(ref, GUID at +0x18) -> GUID to match; m_hero(CV GUID) -> hero
computes: Looks up the hero STU (0xcfe570) for m_hero; if hero +0x58 == the ref GUID it returns true WITHOUT writing the output; else true if any GUID in hero +0x60 list (0x10 stride, GUID at +8) matches, otherwise false. Missing hero: false. Always returns true.
notes: The unwritten-output path is confirmed in the disassembly (JZ to the epilogue): via GetBool it yields the caller's init (INT 0 -> false), so a direct +0x58 match reads as false. Looks like a bug; T016 must reproduce it. Same hero match as 80227402. Name idea [?]: HeroHasTag.

computes: Instance vfunc +0x258 (0x107edc0)(&id): the entity (or its owner via 0x101c5f0) has component 0x66 with +0x3A8 != 0 and 0x101cb60(comp+8 entity) false. Returns false (fail) if inst or inst vfunc +0x30 (self) is null.
notes: Component 0x66 = bit 0x26 of the second mask word (+0xA0/+0xB1). Semantics of +0x3A8 and 0x101cb60 not traced [?]. Invalid id is passed through unchecked.

computes: Integer from the game-mode/match-state object: EA(inst vf+0x60)->vf+0x230 object, RTTI-checked against PTR 0x7ff6517aaf70, ->vf+0x90 ->vf+0x40. False if inst has no EA or the RTTI check fails.
source: match-state object (EA vf+0x230, type PTR_7ff6517aaf70) ->vf+0x90 state ->vf+0x40 (int)
calls: inst vf+0x60; EA vf+0x230; obj vf+8 (IsA), vf+0x90, state vf+0x40; 0xee8ba0 set INT
notes: Same state object as GetRoundWinningTeam (+0x20), GetOvertimeRemaining (+0x30), GetMaxOvertimeLength (+0x38) but reached via EA vf+0x230 instead of EA+0x450->+8->+0x28. Meaning of slot +0x40 unknown [?] (round number / phase?).

computes: Constant 20.0 (0x41A00000). Ignores all arguments; always true.
notes: Hard-coded constant; name unknown. Frees a previous STRING payload in the output before overwriting (standard setter behaviour).

inputs: m_target(CV entity) → key looked up in the map; c4e6bd4e(CV entity) → entity whose component 0x3A is read
computes: Looks up entity c4e6bd4e, takes its component 0x3A, finds the record for m_target's entity id in the component's hash map (+0x30) and outputs record float +0xE8. Record missing → FLT_MAX (3.4028235e38), still true. False if the entity or its component 0x3A is missing.
source: Component 0x3A (AIWeaponAim / per-target perception map at +0x30, keyed by u32 entity id) record +0xE8
calls: inst vf+0x60 → EA vf+0x248; 0xd4c010 hash lookup by entity id (CRC64 table 0x7ff651434c00); 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Both entity CVs: sub-CV evaluated raw (vf+0xD0); used only if it returns true with type ENTITY(11), else invalid id DAT_7ff65183a0c8. Meaning of +0xE8 unknown [?] (distance/threat/time-since-seen for AI targeting); FLT_MAX default suggests a distance or time. Bot/AI-only (0 resident uses).

inputs: m_target(CV entity) → key looked up in the map; c4e6bd4e(CV entity) → entity whose component 0x3A is read
computes: Same as 51f04ae8 but outputs record float +0xEC; returns false (no write) when the record for m_target is missing.
calls: inst vf+0x60 → EA vf+0x248; 0xd4c010 hash lookup; 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Unlike 51f04ae8 there is no FLT_MAX fallback: missing record → false (caller default). Meaning of +0xEC unknown [?].

inputs: fbdafef2(CV entity) → entity whose component 0x3A is read; 6c8fd5a1(CV float) → radius (≤0 = unlimited); 1d953a5e(CV bool) → include flagged records
computes: Counts records in entity's component 0x3A map whose state (+0xD0 int) == 1, that are within radius of the entity's position (squared distance from the record's position +0x40..+0x48) and not flagged (+0x4C5) unless 1d953a5e is true. False if entity or component 0x3A missing.
source: Component 0x3A per-target map (+0x40 bucket count, +0x48 buckets); entity transform (component 0x01) for the centre
calls: inst vf+0x60 → EA vf+0x248; GetFloat 0xcfff50; GetBool 0xd16bf0; 0x1044340 count-in-radius; 0x964bc0 entity position; 0xee8ba0 set INT
notes: Radius ≤ 0 passes a null radius pointer = no distance filter. Likely 'number of perceived/visible targets in range' for AI [?].

inputs: 549c2c51(CV entity) → owner entity; 00324b8c(CV GUID) → entity definition to count
computes: Number of the owner's owned entities (component 0x3E OwnedEntityList) that were spawned from the given definition GUID and are alive (have health 0x28). False if inst/EA null, entity invalid (id==invalid or low 29 bits all set) or the definition GUID is 0.
source: Component 0x3E OwnedEntityList (+0x98 u32 list) of the owner; FUN 0x10bb240 checks definition + health 0x28
calls: inst vf+0x30; GetGUID 0xd00030; 0x107e790 (entity lookup in EA map) → 0x10bb240(EA+0x450->+8->+0x28 object, entity, guid); 0xee8ba0 set INT
notes: param_3 is RTTI-cast (PTR_7ff65176cca0) before reading fields. Typical use: deployable/turret limits ('how many of my X exist').

computes: Local account's level for that hero: profile singleton (0xc44f80) hero-record map at +0xF8 keyed by hero GUID, record +4 (int). Not found → writes INT 0 and returns false.
source: lobby/profile singleton FUN 0xc44f80, hero-record hash map +0xF8 (record +4 = level)
calls: GetGUID 0xd00030; 0xc44f80 profile singleton; 0x5b5cc0 u64-keyed hash lookup; 0xee8ba0 set INT
notes: Data comes from the lobby (profile / hero-stats messages), not from the game server. Returns false (default used) when the hero has no record.

computes: Team of the local player: takes the local player/controller entity id (+0x94 of FUN 0xc5b860 on the EA from inst-scope vf+0x68), looks it up in the EA from vf+0x70 (entity map under spin lock) and outputs its team via 0x101e4d0 (component 0x10 team, else follows a projectile's owner chain). Entity not found → -1. False only if inst or its vf+0x40 object is null.
source: Component 0x10 FilterBits team (0xca99a0) of the local player's entity; fallback owner chain via component 0x27 (+0x1C / +0x1E0)
calls: inst vf+0x40 → obj vf+0x68 / vf+0x70 → vf+0x230 (EA, IsA GameEntityAdmin PTR_7ff6517991e8); 0xc5b860 local-player record; 0x7e74a0 spin lock; 0x101e4d0 entity team; 0xee8ba0 set INT
notes: Proposed name: STUConfigVarGetLocalPlayerTeam [?]. Invalid-id default is DAT_7ff65183a0c8 when no local player. Team values as in component 0x10 (0xffffffff = none).

computes: Team of the entity: helper->EA entity lookup, if it has component 0x10 (FilterBits) returns its team (0xca99a0), else -1 (0xFFFFFFFF). Always true once inst and helper exist (invalid entity → -1).
calls: inst vf+0x30 = entity-query helper (its +0x10 = entity admin; helper->EA vf+0x248 entity lookup); 0x107bac0 (helper vf+0x58 → EA vf+0x248, comp 0x10 → 0xca99a0); 0xee8ba0 set INT
notes: sub-CV evaluated raw (vf+0xD0); used only if it returns true with type ENTITY(11), else invalid id DAT_7ff65183a0c8. Heavily used (198 resident uses): server must replicate component 0x10 team correctly.

computes: Maximum overtime length from the match-state object: EA(inst vf+0x60)+0x450 → +8 → +0x28 object, RTTI-checked (PTR_7ff6517aaf70), vf+0x90 state → vf+0x38 (float). False if RTTI check fails.
source: match-state object at EA+0x450→+8→+0x28 (type PTR_7ff6517aaf70) → vf+0x90 → vf+0x38
calls: inst vf+0x60; obj vf+8 IsA, vf+0x90, vf+0x38; 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Units presumably seconds [?]. The match-state object is the client's gamemode/match brain (see docs/MatchLogic.md); server must drive it.

computes: Overtime remaining: same path as GetMaxOvertimeLength, state vf+0x30 (float).
source: match-state object (EA+0x450→+8→+0x28, type PTR_7ff6517aaf70) → vf+0x90 → vf+0x30
calls: inst vf+0x60; obj vf+8 IsA, vf+0x90, vf+0x30; 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Units presumably seconds [?].

computes: Int +0xC8 of a sub-struct (+0xB0) of component 0x1F reached from the local player's component 0x2F (GameEA local-player id at EA+0x220). False if EA is not a GameEntityAdmin or any link is missing.
source: Component 0x2F LocalPlayer → (0xcf7b10) component 0x1F PawnOwnerLink +0xB0 struct, field +0xC8 (= comp +0x178)
calls: inst vf+0x60 → vf+0x230 (IsA GameEntityAdmin PTR_7ff6517991e8); 0xc5b110 local player comp 0x2F; 0xcf7b10 → comp 0x1F +0xB0; 0xee8ba0 set INT
notes: Siblings ad0d394e (+0xC4) and 3fd35d73 (+0xC0) read adjacent ints of the same struct. Meaning unknown [?] (per-player counters/stats?).

computes: Same as 8ab9197a but field +0xC4 of the component-0x1F +0xB0 struct of the local player.
notes: Meaning unknown [?]; 0xcf7b10 is partly obfuscated, the component-0x1F link is read from its tail.

computes: Same as 8ab9197a but field +0xC0 of the component-0x1F +0xB0 struct of the local player.
notes: Meaning unknown [?]; 0xcf7b10 is partly obfuscated, the component-0x1F link is read from its tail.

inputs: m_entity(CV entity) → entity probing the ground; m_offset(CV, iterated) → list of VEC3 sample offsets; m_height(CV float, default 2.0) → probe height
computes: Samples the ground around the entity at each VEC3 produced by m_offset (iterator 0xf5a740/0xf5a7f0); for each sample 0x107dfb0 probes and yields a pitch. If more than 50% of samples hit, output = max pitch over hits (start -10000), else 90.0. No m_offset → 90.0. False only if inst/helper null.
calls: inst vf+0x30 = entity-query helper (its +0x10 = entity admin; helper->EA vf+0x248 entity lookup); GetFloat 0xcfff50 (m_height, def 2.0); iterator 0xf5a740/0xf5a7f0; 0x107dfb0 ground probe; writes type 3 directly
notes: m_entity is re-evaluated per sample. Output in degrees presumably [?]. Default 90.0 when ground coverage ≤ 50 %. Samples whose type isn't VEC3 reuse the last offset.

computes: Entity's component 0x12 (MovementState) float +0xA2A0 × 57.29578 (rad→deg). Entity invalid/missing component → writes 0.0 and returns false.
calls: inst vf+0x30 (sub-CV is evaluated with the helper as instance!) → vf+0x60 → vf+0x248; 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Probably movement-state pitch/aim angle [?] (sibling 799d8dcd is the yaw from +0xA060 quaternion). Quirk: m_entity is evaluated with inst->vf+0x30 object as the instance argument.

computes: Yaw of the entity's component 0x12 rotation quaternion (+0xA060): rotates the forward vector and returns atan2(x, z) × 57.29578 (degrees). Entity invalid/missing component → writes 0.0 and returns false.
calls: inst vf+0x30 (used as instance for the sub-CV) → vf+0x60 → vf+0x248; 0x1029fb0 quat→yaw (atan2 0x1205b4c); 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Probably movement-state facing yaw in degrees [?]. Same instance-argument quirk as 3dc364bd.

inputs: m_entity(CV entity) → entity; m_hardPoint(CV GUID) → hardpoint id on its model
computes: Resolves the hardpoint's transform on the entity (0x107d590 → 0xa04ea0 on the entity's scene component) and outputs atan2(m[+0x20], m[+0x28]) × 57.29578 (a yaw in degrees). False if the hardpoint lookup fails.
calls: inst vf+0x30 = entity-query helper (its +0x10 = entity admin; helper->EA vf+0x248 entity lookup); GetGUID 0xd00030; 0x107d590 hardpoint transform; 0x1205b4c atan2; 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Name guess: GetHardPointYaw [?]. Degrees.

computes: Entity's component 0x15 (CharacterMover) float +0x35C. Entity lacks component 0x15 → 1.0. Entity invalid/not found → 0.0. Always true once inst and helper exist.
calls: inst vf+0x30, inst vf+0x60 → vf+0x248; 0xee8c00 set FLT (verified in disassembly: comp present → movss [comp+0x35C])
notes: Default 1.0 suggests a multiplier (e.g. movement speed scale) [?].

computes: Health component (0x28) vf+0x68: sum over all health pools with byte flag +0x11 set of pool field +4 (by analogy with max) [?]. Entity found without component 0x28 → output = the entity id bits as float (uninitialised-looking quirk), still true; entity not found → false.
source: Component 0x28 STUHealthComponent (3 pool arrays at +0x98/+0x1D8/+0x318, 16 × 0x14 B entries) vf+0x68
calls: inst vf+0x30 = entity-query helper (its +0x10 = entity admin; helper->EA vf+0x248 entity lookup); 0x107dee0 (comp 0x28 vf+0x68 = 0xcc6d40); 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Health pool entry: +0 int type/active, +4 float (max?), +8 float (current?), +0x11 byte flag. vf+0x50 (combined health) sums +8, vf+0x60 sums +4 → +4=max, +8=current. This one sums +4 where +0x11 set → probably combined max of a subset (e.g. regenerating/shields) [?]. Pairs with f7438661.

computes: Health component (0x28) vf+0x58: sum of current value (+8) over pools with byte flag +0x11 set [?]. Missing component → entity-id bits as float, still true (quirk); entity not found → false.
calls: inst vf+0x30 = entity-query helper (its +0x10 = entity admin; helper->EA vf+0x248 entity lookup); 0x107de10 → comp 0x28 vf+0x58; 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Current-value counterpart of 3d1af60d. Flag +0x11 meaning unknown [?].

inputs: m_entity(CV entity) → entity queried; 36967fde(CV int, default 0) → health pool type/index
computes: Health component (0x28) vf+0x48(pool) value. Missing component → entity-id bits as float, still true (quirk); entity not found → false.
source: Component 0x28 STUHealthComponent vf+0x48 (0xcc6960, not decompilable: obfuscated tail)
calls: inst vf+0x30 = entity-query helper (its +0x10 = entity admin; helper->EA vf+0x248 entity lookup); GetInt 0xcffe50; 0x107dd20 → comp 0x28 vf+0x48(pool); 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Per-pool version of the +0x11-flag sums (by vtable order: +0x30 health, +0x38 max, +0x40/+0x48 two more per-pool getters) [?]. Exact field unreadable (anti-decompile).

inputs: m_entity(CV entity) → entity queried; 36967fde(CV int, default 0) → health pool type/index
computes: Health component (0x28) vf+0x40(pool) value. Missing component → entity-id bits as float, still true (quirk); entity not found → false.
calls: inst vf+0x30 = entity-query helper (its +0x10 = entity admin; helper->EA vf+0x248 entity lookup); GetInt 0xcffe50; 0x107dc30 → comp 0x28 vf+0x40(pool); 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: See 3d225ef4. 50 resident uses each: these two are important HUD/ability health reads, meaning unconfirmed [?].

computes: Health component (0x28) vf+0x60 = sum of field +4 over active pools (entry +0 != 0) → combined max health [?]. Missing component → 0.0 true; entity not found → false.
calls: inst vf+0x30 = entity-query helper (its +0x10 = entity admin; helper->EA vf+0x248 entity lookup); 0x107db50 → comp 0x28 vf+0x60; 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Proposed name: GetEntityCombinedMaxHealth [?] (counterpart of GetEntityCombinedHealth which sums +8).

computes: Health component (0x28) vf+0x50 = sum of current value (+8) over active pools (entry +0 != 0) across the 3 pool arrays. Missing component → 0.0 true; entity not found → false.
calls: inst vf+0x30 = entity-query helper (its +0x10 = entity admin; helper->EA vf+0x248 entity lookup); 0x107da70 → comp 0x28 vf+0x50; 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Health + armor + shields presumably (3 pool arrays) [?].

inputs: m_entity(CV entity) → entity queried; 36967fde(CV int, default 0) → health pool type
computes: Health component (0x28) vf+0x38(pool) = max health of that pool type. Missing component → 0.0 true; entity not found → false.
calls: inst vf+0x30 = entity-query helper (its +0x10 = entity admin; helper->EA vf+0x248 entity lookup); GetInt 0xcffe50; 0x107d970 → comp 0x28 vf+0x38(pool); 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: 36967fde presumably selects the pool (0 health / 1 armor / 2 shields?) [?].

inputs: m_entity(CV entity) → entity queried; 36967fde(CV int, default 0) → health pool type
computes: Health component (0x28) vf+0x30(pool) = current health of that pool type. Missing component → 0.0 true; entity not found → false.
calls: inst vf+0x30 = entity-query helper (its +0x10 = entity admin; helper->EA vf+0x248 entity lookup); GetInt 0xcffe50; 0x107d870 → comp 0x28 vf+0x30(pool); 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Server must replicate component 0x28 health pools for HUD/abilities.

computes: Player slot: entity's component 0x3F (PlayerInfo) byte +0xC0 (zero-extended); entity has no 0x3F → 0. False if sub-CV fails/invalid id or entity not found.
calls: inst vf+0x60 → vf+0x248; 0xee8ba0 set INT (read from disassembly; Ghidra output is broken)
notes: Uses movzx: slot is unsigned 0..255 in the output even though m_slot is s8 in the STU.

computes: Entity pitch in degrees: from the entity's aim/view data (0x103ff20 → +0x240) if present, else from its transform (0x9348d0); × 57.29578. Entity not found → false (out 0).
source: aim/view state (0x103ff20 record +0x240) or scene transform component 0x01
calls: inst vf+0x30 = entity-query helper (its +0x10 = entity admin; helper->EA vf+0x248 entity lookup); 0x107c8e0; 0x103ff20; 0x9348d0; 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Degrees.

computes: Entity yaw in degrees: atan2 of its transform forward (component 0x01 via 0x896d20) × 57.29578. Invalid id or entity not found → false.
calls: inst vf+0x30 = entity-query helper (its +0x10 = entity admin; helper->EA vf+0x248 entity lookup); 0x107c750; 0x896d20 transform; 0x1205b4c atan2; 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Degrees. 71 resident uses.

inputs: a3fe58ce(CV position) → point A; 4d832c7b(CV position) → point B
computes: Angle of A − B in degrees: atan2(dy, dx) × 57.29578 using the first two components; 0.0 if |dx| or |dy| is 0. False only if inst vf+0x60 returns null.
calls: GetPosition 0xd55240 (default vec DAT_7ff65188f6a0); 0x1205b4c atan2; 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Quirk: returns 0 when either delta component is exactly 0 (so pure axis-aligned directions give 0, not ±90/180). Axis choice (x,y) — check against the game's up axis [?].

inputs: m_pos(CV position) → target point; a3fe58ce(CV position, optional) → origin (default camera position); m_sceneType(enum) → 0 = main game camera/local player, else UI/scene-world viewport
computes: Screen-space direction angle to a point: transforms (m_pos − origin) into the camera/local-player frame, normalises, and outputs atan2 of the larger-magnitude of two view components vs −x, × 57.29578 (degrees); degenerate → 0. Always true once inst vf+0x60 is non-null.
source: camera: EA vf+0xE8 → +0x48 (sceneType 0) or scene-world comp 0x55 viewport (0xc57dd0 → +0x28); local player transform (0xc5b860 → comp 0x01) for sceneType 0
calls: GetPosition 0xd55240; inst vf+0x70 → vf+0x230 (IsA GameEntityAdmin); 0xc5b860; 0xc57dd0; 0x896d20; 0x1205b4c atan2; 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Used for off-screen indicators / direction arrows [?]. Decompile is partly garbled; exact axis pairing should be verified live.

inputs: bbf5a51c(CV float) → max screen distance (pixels, squared internally)
computes: Index of the component-0x62 registry record (records 0x20 B, count +0x20) whose UI-scaled screen position (+0x10..+0x18 × UI scale DAT_7ff651886688+0x93C) is nearest to the viewport centre ((+0x104−+0xFC)/2, (+0x108−+0x100)/2), within the radius; skips records with +0x1C < 0. None → -1. False only if inst/helper null.
source: comp 0x62 registry (0xc580e0 = EA+0xB0+0x930); view object EA vf+0xE8 → +0x48 viewport rect; UI manager DAT_7ff651886688+0x93C scale
calls: inst vf+0x30 → vf+0x70 → vf+0x230 (IsA GameEntityAdmin); 0xc580e0; 0xd13660; GetFloat 0xcfff50; writes INT directly
notes: 'Which screen marker is under the crosshair' [?]. -1 also when not in a GameEntityAdmin.

computes: Largest number of allied (non-hostile incl. self) players sharing one hero: iterates component 0x3F PlayerInfo of the global game EA, takes each player's hero (+0xB0 if its visibility flag +0xC1 (self)/+0xC2 (others) is set, else 0xc04280), counts per distinct hero, outputs max count (0 if none). False only if inst/helper null.
source: global game EA DAT_7ff651797f90, component 0x3F PlayerInfo (+0xB0 hero, +0xC1/+0xC2 flags); hostility test 0x101d2b0
calls: 0xc5a0d0 local player entity; 0x9d79f0/0x9d80b0 component iterator (EA+0xB0+0x5E8); 0x101d2b0 is-hostile; 0xc04280; writes INT directly
notes: Hero-stacking counter for hero-select UI [?]. Uses the global EA, not the instance's EA.

computes: Number of allied (non-hostile incl. self) players who have a hero (component 0x3F: +0xB0 when flag +0xC1/+0xC2 set, else 0xc04280, non-zero).
source: global game EA DAT_7ff651797f90, component 0x3F PlayerInfo
notes: Proposed name: team players-with-hero count [?]. Always true once inst/helper exist.

computes: Reads a float from the view/camera object of the global game EA (EA vf+0xE8 → +0x48): 0 → +0x9B8, 1 → +0x9BC, 2 → +0x9C0 × 57.29578 (an angle, rad→deg), 3 → +0x9C4; other enum values → false.
notes: Field meanings unknown except index 2 is an angle (FOV?) [?].

inputs: a7947530(CV float) → cone angle in degrees (full angle)
computes: Screen-space radius of a cone: tan(angle × 0.5 × π/180) × (UI dimension DAT_7ff651886688+0x938) / tan(camera +0xE0). False if the camera (EA vf+0xE8 → +0x40) is null.
source: camera object (global game EA vf+0xE8 → +0x40, +0xE0 = half FOV in rad [?]); UI manager DAT_7ff651886688 +0x938 (screen height/2 [?])
notes: Pixels [?]. Client-only (reticle/spread UI).

computes: Pending invite count: length of the friends manager's (0xc47c00) linked list at +0xA8. Always true.
calls: 0xc47c00 friends manager; 0x61da30 array grow; writes INT directly
notes: Documented in docs/LobbyScripts.md as PendingInviteCount. Lobby-side data.

computes: Online friend count: friends manager (0xc47c00) → 0xcd8e50 counts entries whose presence record has (0x424E, 2, 1) and online flag +0x98 set. Always true.
notes: Documented in docs/LobbyScripts.md as OnlineFriendCount. Lobby-side data.

computes: Uniform random integer in [min(m_min,m_max), max(m_min,m_max)] inclusive: lo + (rand_u32 % (hi − lo + 1)). Always true.
calls: 0x87b390 random int (u32 % (n+1); n == -1 → raw u32); writes INT directly
notes: Client-local RNG: server and client values will differ; if hi−lo == 0xFFFFFFFF the raw u32 is used.

computes: u32 +0xD0 of lobby singleton component 0x58 (CombatMessageState, filled by ClientInCombat message 25009). Always true.
notes: Lobby-message driven (25009) [see docs/ECS_Components.md 0x58]; meaning of the value unknown [?].

computes: Winning team of the round from the match-state object (EA+0x450→+8→+0x28, RTTI PTR_7ff6517aaf70) → vf+0x90 → vf+0x20. False if RTTI check fails.
calls: inst vf+0x60; obj vf+8 IsA, vf+0x90, vf+0x20; 0xee8ba0 set INT
notes: Team id encoding as component 0x10 [?].

inputs: m_string(CV) → string source: GUID of a string asset, or any value converted to text
computes: Length of a string: if m_string evaluates as a non-zero GUID, loads that (localized) string asset (0x852ee0) and outputs its length (+0x10); otherwise evaluates m_string raw, converts types 1..9 to text (0xee9250, 256-byte buffer) and outputs strlen. Failure → 0. Always true.
calls: GetGUID 0xd00030; raw sub-CV vf+0xD0; 0xee9250 to-string; 0x852ee0 string asset; writes INT directly
notes: Types 10/11 (ColorRGBA, ENTITY) are not converted → 0. Asset string length is in bytes/UTF-8 units [?].

computes: Uniform random float: m_min + rand01 × (m_max − m_min), rand01 = rand_u32 × 2^-32 in [0,1). Always true.
notes: Client-local RNG (not synced). Works with min > max too.

computes: Outputs m_value. Always true.
notes: Most used config var (2011 resident uses).

computes: 'On fire' meter percentage: local player's (0xc5a0d0 on the EA from 0xc029d0, which prefers the replay manager's EA while replay state is 7/8) component 0x34 floats: out = min(+0xE0, +0xE4×1.25) / (+0xE4×1.25) × 100. Always true.
source: component 0x34 of the local player (+0xE0 score, +0xE4 threshold)
calls: 0xc029d0 (EA or replay EA DAT_7ff651797fc0+0xB8); 0xc5a0d0 local player; 0xee8c00 set FLT
notes: Quirk: without component 0x34 (or +0xE4 = 0) the result is 0/0 = NaN. Capped at 100 (score ≥ 1.25 × threshold). Component 0x34 is documented as PlayerSlotLists (low confidence) — it evidently holds the fire score here.

inputs: m_entity(CV entity) → whose movement throttle is read (optional)
computes: Movement input axes of an entity as (x, y) = two signed bytes / 127. If m_entity is null or is the local controller's entity, reads the local input state (bytes +8/+9); otherwise reads the current input record of the entity's MovementState (Component 0x12, bytes +0x1B0/+0x1B1). Entity lacks Component 0x12 → (0,0,0), still true.
source: local: EntityAdmin(inst->vf+0x60)+0x450 controller ->vf+0x30 input state bytes +8/+9; remote: Component 0x12 input ring (entry = +0x440 + idx(+0xA050)*0x270) bytes +0x1B0/+0x1B1
calls: inst vf+0x60 (entity admin) → vf+0x248 entity lookup; 0xc23580 (current input record of MovementState)
notes: Scale 0.007874 = 1/127. Only out.x/out.y are written on the success paths (type set to VEC3, z keeps the Primitive's previous z); the zero path writes (0,0,0). Always returns true. Invalid-id check also rejects ids with (id & 0x1fffffff)==0x1fffffff.

inputs: m_valueX(CV float) → x; m_valueY(CV float) → y; m_valueZ(CV float) → z
computes: Builds a VEC3 from three float config vars (each defaults to 0 on failure). Returns false only when inst is null.
notes: Evaluation order z, y, x (irrelevant unless side effects).

computes: Literal: copies the three floats at +0x10/+0x14/+0x18 into a VEC3. Always true.
notes: Field type 81ebb9b0 is a plain 3-float vector; w not stored.

computes: Literal: copies two floats (+0x10,+0x14) into out.x/out.y and sets type VEC3. Always true.
notes: z is NOT written: it keeps whatever the Primitive held (0 for a fresh Primitive). Treat as (x, y, 0) [?].

inputs: m_posA(CV position) → point A; m_posB(CV position) → point B
computes: Horizontal (XZ-plane) distance between two positions: sqrt((Bx-Ax)^2 + (Bz-Az)^2), Y ignored; 0 when the squared distance ≤ 1e-35ish epsilon. Always true.
notes: Outputs a FLOAT although it sits under STUConfigVarVecBase. sqrt via rsqrtss + one Newton step (tiny float error). Name proposal: STUConfigVarHorizontalDistance [?].

inputs: m_entity(CV entity) → reference frame; m_offset(CV position/vec) → local-space point
computes: Transforms m_offset from the entity's local space to world space with the entity's Component 0x01 world matrix (point transform incl. translation). If m_entity is null/invalid or has no Component 0x01, returns m_offset unchanged. Always true.
calls: GetPosition 0xd55240; inst vf+0x60 → vf+0x248 entity lookup; 0x896d20 world matrix
notes: Uses the render/scene transform (Component 0x01) directly, not the movement state.

inputs: b0c994d6(CV pos) → look-at point P; 2c419df5(CV pos) → origin O; f7e8d02a(CV vec) → start offset (used when behavior==1); 70e0c7ba(CV vec) → desired local offset; m_collisionRadius(CV float, default 0.2) → sweep radius; 142abd7e(CV) → not read by GetValue; m_collisionBehavior(enum +0x40) → cast start mode
computes: Collision-safe offset position (camera-boom style): builds a frame with forward = normalize(P−O), right = up×forward, up' = forward×right; target = O + frame·offset(70e0c7ba). Sweeps a sphere (radius) from O (or, if behavior==1, from P + frame·f7e8d02a) to target via the physics world; on hit returns hit point + 1.0·dir(target→start), else target. Returns false if inst null, the instance's entity admin is not a GameEntityAdmin, or no physics world.
source: physics world (0xc14540 singleton → vf0) sweep 0x9f76c0; entity admin via inst->vf+0x70->vf+0x230 (type check PTR 0x7ff6517991e8)
notes: Up axis = static (0,1,0) [?] (DAT_7ff65188f720 row of identity). Hit pull-back constant is 1.0 world unit (DAT_7ff65160f6a0) toward the start. Field +0x38 unused here (maybe used by the +0xD8 vfunc). Proposed name: STUConfigVarCollisionSafeOffset [?]. Client/physics-only; server likely does not need it.

inputs: m_inputs(CV entity set/list) → candidate entities; d4b3ae53(CV float, default −1 → auto) → distance/radius; dfdac7f0(CV pos) → reference point; 24dfb909(CV vec) → offset
computes: For each entity from m_inputs with Component 0x01 + a physics object: takes its model bounds and hard point GUID 0x0dc00000000000a1, generates 8 candidate points around it at a radius (d4b3ae53, or bounds extent×1.5 when unset, min 0.05), ray-tests each via the physics world and returns the unobstructed candidate with the greatest Y (or, if all hit, the best pulled-back hit). Fallback: collision-safe offset (0xd90b90, as 6f8414fe) around the first entity's world position. False if m_inputs null or nothing found. [?] (large function, read at summary level)
notes: Details (exact candidate layout, scoring direction, radius constants 1.5/0.9/0.05) are [?]. Looks like a camera/spectator or spawn-placement helper; client-visual, low priority for the server. Proposed name: STUConfigVarFindClearPositionAroundEntities [?].

inputs: 93c1a2ad(CV float, degrees) → yaw; 0089edcf(CV float, degrees) → pitch
computes: Unit direction from yaw/pitch in degrees: (sin(yaw)·cos(pitch), −sin(pitch), cos(yaw)·cos(pitch)) (row 2 of RotY(yaw)·RotX(pitch)). Always true.
notes: Inverse of 663394d9. Degrees→radians 0.017453292. Positive pitch points down (−Y). Proposed name: STUConfigVarDirectionFromAngles [?].

inputs: 0219eab2(CV vec) → vector A; fa0d02b9(CV vec) → plane normal N
computes: Projects A onto the plane perpendicular to N: A − (A·n)n with n = normalize(N) (if the result is ~0, the helper returns an arbitrary unit perpendicular). Returns false (output untouched) when the result's squared length < epsilon.
notes: If N is ~zero the helper returns zero vector → false. Result not normalized. Proposed name: STUConfigVarProjectOnPlane [?].

computes: The AI facing vector of an entity, from instance vfunc +0x248(out, entityId, default=(0,0,0)). Invalid entity → the instance returns the zero default. Returns true whenever inst and inst->vf+0x30 are non-null.
notes: Implementation behind vf+0x248 not traced. Server: probably AI-only; zero for players [?].

inputs: 120ddd57(CV vec) → direction A (to clamp); 556d3f86(CV vec) → reference direction B; 5898cae1(CV float, degrees, default 0) → max yaw deviation; ba5686ad(CV float, degrees, default 0) → max pitch deviation
computes: Clamps direction A to within ±maxYaw/±maxPitch of direction B in yaw/pitch space: yaw' = A.yaw unless |wrap(B.yaw−A.yaw)|>maxYaw, then B.yaw∓maxYaw (same for pitch); outputs the unit vector for (yaw', pitch'). A ~zero → false with (0,0,0); B ~zero → false with zero vector.
calls: GetPosition 0xd55240 ×2, GetFloat 0xcfff50 ×2, atan2 0x1205b4c, asin 0x1355404, angle diff 0xf09150, 0xf06bd0/0x95e220
notes: yaw = atan2(x, z), pitch = asin(clamp(−y,−1,1)); inputs normalized first. Angle diff wraps to [−π, π]. Proposed name: STUConfigVarClampDirectionToCone [?].

inputs: e989044f(CV bool) → local→world (true) or world→local (false); 2579faf0(CV vec) → direction; m_entity(CV entity) → reference frame; m_hardPoint(CV GUID) → optional hard point on the entity
computes: Rotates a direction vector by the entity's hard-point matrix (if m_hardPoint set and found) or else its world transform (movement-object rotation, fallback Component 0x01); with the bool false it uses the inverse (transpose/scale²) instead. Only the 3×3 part is applied (no translation). False if entity invalid or no transform.
source: Component 0x01 hard point matrix (0x107c080 → 0xa04ea0) or entity transform (0x107cbf0)
notes: Bool default false → world→local. Proposed name: STUConfigVarTransformDirection [?].

inputs: a8a3e0f7(CV vec) → offset V; m_pivotPos(CV pos) → pivot P; 955d10cd(CV float, degrees) → angle; 365e1278(enum +0x28) → axis 0=X,1=Y,2=Z
computes: Rotates V by angle (degrees) around the chosen axis, then adds P: out = Rot_axis(angle)·V + P. Axis value outside 0..2 → no rotation. False only if inst null.
notes: V is not made relative to P first (rotate offset then translate). Sign conventions: X: y'=c·y−s·z, z'=s·y+c·z; Y: x'=c·x+s·z, z'=c·z−s·x; Z: x'=c·x−s·y, y'=s·x+c·y. Proposed name: STUConfigVarRotateAroundPivot [?].

computes: Direction → angles in degrees: out.x = yaw = atan2(x, z) (0 if x and z are both 0), out.y = pitch = asin(clamp(−y, −1, 1)); input normalized if not unit. Always true (if inst non-null).
notes: Only x and y are written (z keeps the previous Primitive z). Zero input → (0, 0). Inverse of 45a80dd1. Proposed name: STUConfigVarDirectionToAngles [?].

inputs: 566e9b3e(CV vec) → direction A; 2c70ef65(CV vec) → direction B
computes: Signed angle difference B−A in yaw/pitch, degrees: out.x = wrap(yawB−yawA), out.y = wrap(pitchB−pitchA) with yaw = atan2(x,z), pitch = asin(−y), wrap to [−180°,180°]. Either vector ~zero → false with out.xy = a runtime default (DAT_7ff6518d3ba8).
notes: Only x,y written. Proposed name: STUConfigVarAngleDelta [?]. 37 resident uses: likely aim/turn logic.

inputs: m_entity(CV entity) → entity; m_hardPoint(CV GUID) → hard point
computes: World position of a hard point (attachment) on the entity's model, from the Component 0x01 (render/visual) transform directly: translation row of the hard point matrix. False if entity missing or hard point not found.
notes: 'Visual' variant: no simulation scope (0x107f5a0) — reads the interpolated render transform [?].

computes: Entity world position from Component 0x01 (visual transform, 0x964bc0). False if entity not found.
notes: Visual (render-interpolated [?]) position; server equivalent = entity position.

computes: Entity facing = row 2 (forward) of the Component 0x01 world matrix. False if entity not found.
notes: Visual variant of 91c4af3f.

computes: Screen-space size of the entity's bounding box: projects the 8 corners of its Component 0x01 bounds through the current view [?] and returns (width, height, 0) of the 2D rect. False if inst/entity/Component 0x01/view is missing.
source: Component 0x01 bounds (0xa03250), view/camera via inst->vf+0x40->vf+0x70 → 0xd13660 → vf+0xE8 [?]
calls: GetEntity 0xd16cf0; inst vf+0x60 → vf+0x248; 0xcf0520 (project bbox → rect); 0xa1fa70 (project point [?])
notes: Not world-space dimensions despite the name [?]: the 2D rect (units depend on 0xa1fa70's projection). Client-only (UI).

inputs: m_entity(CV entity) → entity; m_hardPoint(CV GUID) → hard point
computes: World position of a hard point on the entity (translation row of the hard point matrix from 0xa04ea0), read inside the simulation scope (0x107f5a0 mode 0). False if entity missing or hard point not found.
notes: Non-visual counterpart of 827387ee.

computes: Entity 'base' position: Component 0x01 world position; if the entity has Component 0x15 (CharacterMover) and a movement object, adds comp15 vector(+0x60..+0x6C) × (height(+0x2D8 standing / +0x2E4 when mover flag 0x198 bit1 [crouch?]) + mover+0x1B8 when (flags & 0xC)==0 + 0.004). False if entity not found.
source: Component 0x01 position, Component 0x15 (+0x60 axis, +0x2D8/+0x2E4 heights), movement object (+0x198 flags, +0x1B8)
notes: Which way the comp15 +0x60 vector points (down → feet, up → eye) is [?]; name says base, so presumably feet/ground point. Characters only; others = transform position.

computes: Entity world position via instance vfunc +0xB8(entityId, &vec3) (entity id → position). False when that vfunc fails (entity unknown) or inst null.
notes: Most used vector CV (153 resident uses). Server must answer entity positions for it.

computes: Velocity of the surface the entity stands on: needs Component 0x12 (MovementState) and a movement object with a ground entity (0x102a540); returns that ground entity's Component 0x01 vector at +0x130..+0x13C [velocity?]. Otherwise (0,0,0). True whenever entity lookup path ran (helper always returns 1).
source: Component 0x12 + movement object ground entity; ground entity Component 0x01 +0x130
notes: Zero when not on a moving platform [?]. Returns true even for a missing entity (zero vector).

computes: Entity velocity from its movement object (0x102a350), requires Component 0x12 (MovementState); otherwise (0,0,0). Helper always returns true, so this succeeds whenever inst is valid.
notes: Units per second [?]. Zero for entities without MovementState.

computes: Entity up vector = row 1 of its world rotation (movement-object orientation quaternion when present, else Component 0x01 matrix). False if entity not found.
source: movement object orientation (0x1029de0) or Component 0x01 matrix
notes: Matrix rows: 0 = left, 1 = up, 2 = forward, 3 = position.

computes: Entity left vector = row 0 of its world rotation (movement object or Component 0x01). False if entity not found.
source: movement object orientation or Component 0x01 matrix
notes: Row 0 = up × forward [?]; Overwatch is left-handed-ish: row 0 named 'left'.

computes: Entity forward vector = row 2 of its world rotation (movement object orientation when present, else Component 0x01 matrix). False if entity not found.
source: movement object orientation or Component 0x01 matrix
notes: Body orientation; see 91c4af3f for the (aim) facing.

computes: Entity facing vector: movement object's facing (0x102b750) when the entity has one, else row 2 of the Component 0x01 matrix. False if entity not found.
notes: For characters probably the aim/look direction (incl. pitch) [?] vs forward (body). 85 resident uses.

computes: Looks up entry m_id in a list obtained from a GameEntityAdmin system (0xc580e0; entries 0x20 bytes, count at +0x20, array at +0x18) and returns its vec3 at +0x10 scaled by a global float (DAT_7ff651886688+0x93C). Out of range / wrong admin → (0,0,0), still true.
source: GameEntityAdmin system via 0xc580e0 (obfuscated system-table lookup, admin+0xB0 +0x930); scale global +0x93C
notes: Which list (map points / spawn / path nodes?) is [?]; needs a live look at the system. Name unknown: STUConfigVarGetIndexedPoint [?].

computes: Literal colour: each float channel ×255 truncated to a byte, packed R,G,B,A (low→high). Always true.
notes: Conversion is (char)(int64)(f×255): truncation, no clamping (values >1 wrap).

inputs: 32410b8f(CV float, default 1.0) → alpha multiplier; dc1e3375(enum +0x18, 0..6) → which colour
computes: Picks one of 7 RGBA colours from a globally loaded colour-settings asset (system via 0xc4b590 on DAT_7ff651813e18, resource handle at +0xC8; colour i at +8+0x10·i), multiplies alpha by the float, packs ×255 to ColorRGBA. If the asset isn't loaded, output is left untouched. Always true.
source: colour table asset from a global system (0xc4b590(DAT_7ff651813e18)+0xC8 handle)
notes: Enum outside 0..6 uses runtime defaults DAT_7ff6517a5ef8. The 7 slots are probably team/UI palette colours (friendly/enemy/…) [?]. Proposed name: STUConfigVarUIColor / GameColor [?].

inputs: m_hero(CV GUID) → hero STU; 32410b8f(CV float, default 1.0) → alpha multiplier
computes: Hero's colour: looks up the hero asset by GUID (0x9c6470) and packs its RGBA floats at +0x168..+0x174 (×255, alpha × multiplier). Hero not found → output untouched. Always true.
notes: Same byte packing as d4e0b6a8.

computes: Takes the first component of type 0x58 in the global GameEntityAdmin (DAT_7ff651813e18, list at admin+0xB0+0x58*0x18) and outputs the u32 entity id stored at component+0xD4. Always returns true.
notes: No null check on the component: if no 0x58 component exists it would read address 0xD4 (crash) [?, decompile shows no guard]. Instance and CV unused. Component 0x58 identity unknown (a singleton-ish 'global' entity holder [?]). Name unknown.

computes: Gets the entity admin for the instance (inst vfunc +0x70 -> vfunc +0x230), and if it is the global GameEntityAdmin (DAT_7ff651813e18) or is of the GameEntityAdmin RTTI (PTR 0x7ff6517991e8) with admin vfunc +0xE0 non-null, outputs *(admin->vfunc+0xE0()->vfunc0()). Otherwise outputs invalid id. Always true.
source: entity admin vfunc +0xE0 object (global entity holder) vfunc 0 -> entity id
notes: 'Global entity' = one entity per GameEntityAdmin (map/global logic entity [?]). Server must make sure this entity exists/its id is known; returns INVALID in lobby admins.

computes: Uses global object DAT_7ff651797fc0 (+8 entity id, +0x10 id array, +0x18 count, +0xB8 entity table). If +8 is invalid: returns the first id in the array that resolves to a live entity. Else: resolves +8, and if that entity has component 0x20 outputs comp0x20+0x94 (view target). Otherwise outputs invalid. Always true.
notes: Returns invalid id if the global is null. Identity of the global unknown; likely a spectator/camera-follow entity list [?]. Name unknown.

inputs: fbdafef2(CV entity) → entity queried; 1d953a5e(CV bool, GetBool default false) → include flagged entries
computes: Resolves the entity; if it has component 0x3A, iterates the list at comp+0x48 (count +0x40) and outputs the id (+0x18) of the entry nearest (squared distance to entry pos +0x40/+0x44/+0x48) to the entity's position, skipping entries whose byte +0x4C5 is set unless the bool is true. Returns false when the entity lacks component 0x3A.
